claims.text: Ceviche is raw fish cured in citrus juice, usually lime or bitter orange.
Ceviche is not cured mainly in salt water, coconut milk or soy sauce.
Citric acid denatures fish proteins much as heat does, turning the flesh firm and opaque.
The citrus turns the surface of the fish opaque within minutes.
